description: This Java class 'BodyDTODeserializer' is a custom deserializer for 'BodyDTO' objects, used within the MockServer project to parse JSON representations of various body types (e.g., JSON, XML, regex, base64) into corresponding Java objects. It handles different content types, encodings, and parameters, and is part of the serialization/deserialization infrastructure of MockServer.

classes.name: BodyDTODeserializer
classes.description: A custom Jackson deserializer for 'BodyDTO' objects, capable of parsing various body representations from JSON into Java objects, handling different content types, encodings, and parameters.

methods.description: Main method to deserialize JSON input into a 'BodyDTO' object, handling different JSON token types and content structures.
